name: Fleet Atlas
notes: Attach pass: every player and NPC hull keeps engines, weapons, antennae, radiators, clamps, and dishes on the body. Dart stern notches and off-wing hardpoints are gone; planforms grew transoms, engine shoulders, and wing roots so fittings sit in or on the hull.
Hangar cards and local-space draws share the same attached geometry. Flight, docking, hitboxes, and menus are unchanged. Stars stay the 2.15.0 spectral pass.
Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.15.3 so Pages picks up the attached craft paint.
